name: Elixir
description: Restores the PP of all moves by 10.

gifts.mapName: Sootopolis City Lotad And Seedot House
gifts.note: Show him a bigger Lotad. This brother keeps a Lotad size record. Show him a Lotad from your party or PC that beats the record and he gives you an Elixir. Every new record earns another. The house is shut during the Groudon and Kyogre crisis.

gifts.mapName: Sootopolis City Lotad And Seedot House
gifts.note: Show him a bigger Seedot. This brother keeps a Seedot size record. Show him a Seedot from your party or PC that beats the record and he gives you an Elixir. Every new record earns another. The house is shut during the Groudon and Kyogre crisis.
